notes.hook: Strong opening premise effectively piques viewer curiosity immediately.

notes.payoff: Satisfying explanation reveals the deliberate Titan gravity assist.

notes.loop: Final statement connects seamlessly back into the opening hook.

rounds.better_than_last: This episode maintains tighter pacing and stronger thematic cohesion than recent shorts.
